Thanks for the write-up. I reviewed the forecast and the ask. Given the strategic reseller relationship and the MGC, I am prepared to approve a temporary 70/30 rev-share (MerchantOps 70%) for the first 12 months on marketplace-recognized usage only, with the following conditions:

- The MGC of $250,000 must be contractually binding and payable to Redwood in the event of early termination or material shortfall.
- The 70/30 split reverts automatically to Redwood standard (80/20) after 12 months; include an explicit audit right for Redwood to validate reported marketplace usage.
- Payout schedule remains Marketplace-defined but Redwood will require MerchantOps provide a reconciliation statement within 30 days of each Marketplace payout; any disputes subject to net-off against MGC.
- No external listing or resale carveouts beyond what MerchantOps can show as Marketplace-recognized invoices.
- Legal to include a sunset clause and clear language that this is a one-time, non-precedential exception.

Marissa/karthik — please proceed to draft the private offer in the Marketplace console reflecting these bullets; Legal to produce redlines and Finance to confirm cashflow timing (Net90 exposure acceptable if MGC terms satisfy). Once we have the redlined offer, I will sign the exec approval email to the Marketplace team.

Irene — please coordinate with Samir to get signatures on the MGC language and have MerchantOps countersign digitally (DocuSign link preferred).

-Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Worldwide Sales
